description: This file defines a factory class 'UserRoleManagerFactory' that provides access to instances of 'AbstractUserRoleManager', managing their lifecycle and retrieval, primarily for user role management within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for providing instances of AbstractUserRoleManager, implementing singleton pattern and refresh capabilities.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of user role manager, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getNewUserRoleManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of user role manager, typically called when session details change.

methods.name: updateUserRoleManager
methods.description: Updates the stored user role manager instance to a new one, reflecting session changes.
